subject.title: feat(ui): show voice activity while Talk is listening

question: Should Control UI Talk replace the static listening status with a microphone-level visualizer now, and should that first version cover all browser realtime transports?
rationale: The request is clear and aligned, but it is new user-facing UI behavior on a protected maintainer-labeled issue and spans visual design, accessibility, and transport coverage.

options.title: Sponsor the shared visualizer
options.body: Implement the visualizer across the shared Control UI Talk state path so all supported browser realtime transports can feed the same composer UI.

options.title: Stage by transport
options.body: Start with Gateway relay and Google Live where PCM samples already pass through JS audio processors, then separately decide WebRTC local metering.

options.title: Keep static status
options.body: Leave the current text-only Talk status until maintainers want a broader voice UI refresh.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared visualizer
recommendation.body: Implement the visualizer across the shared Control UI Talk state path so all supported browser realtime transports can feed the same composer UI.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the issue, applied the maintainer-protected direction signal, and is visible in recent Control UI history.
